{"reason": "Most failure rows (inventory-days 10.0-13.2 vs regular-lead 4-8, risk-materialized=#f/#t) pay 45000 supplier-switch cost when monitoring is safe: with inventory-days>=9 the regular delivery (max lead 8) arrives first, so no stockout. Adding a monitor branch for medium/high risk above that threshold cuts cost per 40 events without raising the 4 stockouts.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high)) (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (>= inventory-days 9))
     (list 'monitor))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'suggest-alternative-supplier))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
